newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Feb registered unemployment barely changed.
newsitem.headline: Greek Feb registered unemployment barely changed.

text.p: Greece's registered unemployment was barely changed at 9.25 percent in February from 9.27 percent in January, the labour ministry said in a statement.

The number of unemployed rose slightly to 226,273 in February from 225,688 in January and 221,192 in February 1995 but the number of employed increased to 2,218,492 in February from 2,207,619 in January, it said.
Layoffs stood at 13,221 and hirings 30,944 in February, the ministry said.
Registered unemployment is known to be lower than actual unemployment but there are no monthly actual unemployment figures. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
